profile.headline: Data Platform Engineer | Remote Sensing & Geospatial Data Pipelines
profile.summary:
Perpetually curious and impact-driven machine learning and MLOps engineer. 

I've held leadership roles on data science and machine learning teams, where I have scaled the training and inference of machine learning algorithms to put models into production and built user-friendly, traceable platforms for data ETL, model training and evaluation.

Skilled and passionate about leveling-up code quality, containerizing repeatable workflows, building CI/CD pipelines, and training data science team members on cloud technologies. 

I have a background in environmental and agricultural sciences and data science. I have extensive experience in the analysis of earth observation and other geospatial data using machine learning and deep learning techniques.

positions.description: Designed and developed pipelines for data science algorithms and EO data product generation. Built MLOps platforms and tools for rapid training, evaluation and deployment of deep learning models operating on earth observation data at continental scale.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
The Biogeography Lab uses quantitative methods to study crop ecology, agricultural biodiversity, and agricultural development and their effects on the health, and wealth of people.

Leverage data science methods, including the application of various machine learning algorithms, to model spatial-temporal patterns in cropping systems and agricultural landscapes.

company.name: University of California, Davis - Biogeography Lab

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Managed the intellectual property development process for several clients primarily in the clean tech/renewables industries. 
 
Drafted, filed, and prosecuted US and international patent applications; Performed IP diligence including freedom-to-operate, infringement and validity analyses; Supported business development transactions through diligence and licensing agreement work.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
The Horticulture Innovation Lab is a USAID-funded program focused on the development of international projects and partnerships that improve livelihoods for resource-poor fruit and vegetable producers. The program, led by researchers and staff at UC Davis, was established as part of the U.S. Government's Feed the Future Initiative. 

Designed and conducted experiment to compare effects of two low-cost, passive drying technologies on nutrient degradation in fruit. 

Performed model selection and conducted statistical analyses to determine significance of treatment effects and differences in treatment group means (using the ‘lsmeans’ package in R). 

Prepared manuscript on findings; submitted August 2017: "Effect of Passive Drying on Ascorbic Acid, Alpha-Tocopherol, and Beta-Carotene in Tomato and Mango"

company.name: University of California, Davis - Horticulture Innovation Lab

positions.title: Intellectual Property Manager; Special Projects Coordinator
positions.description:
Managed Inventure's intellectual property portfolio including multiple US, foreign, and international patents and patent applications.

Drafted, filed, and prosecuted US and international patent applications.

Oversaw IP diligence efforts including freedom-to-operate analyses; Supported business development transactions through diligence and agreement work.

Supported business development efforts through project development and market research and analytics in a number of areas including agricultural supply chains, fuel and chemical markets, and emerging biofuel technologies (feedstocks and conversion pathways).

positions.title: Content Manager (contract)
positions.description:
Acquired, developed, and managed data content for Elsevier Biofuel TechSelect; edited content against quality standards.

Liaised with Development Partners throughout the global biofuel supply chain to ensure the completeness and validity of supplied data.

Provided expert review and worked with Development Partners to identify and remedy issues with data that was determined to be insufficient, inaccurate, or unsubstantiated.

Collaborated with the Carbon War Room and other partners on the product development and user testing of the database.

Monitored status and progress of content acquisition through weekly and monthly reports against Key Performance Indicators (KPI's).

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
Analyzed and reported on feedstocks, technologies, sustainability criteria, relevant policies, market trends, and supply chain logistics in the advanced biofuel industry. 

Represented Qatar Airways and the Qatar Advanced Biofuel Platform in industry forums and with biofuel organizations.

Performed due diligence and research and analysis of feedstock developers and technology providers in the advanced biofuel industry to provide project and fuel supply recommendations for clients.

Led efforts to develop relational database comprised of Verno knowledge base and other materials.
positions.insights: Skills: Environmental Science · Agriculture · Renewable Energy

positions.title: Agronomy Intern
positions.description:
Participated in agronomic and crop development projects associated with several tropical, perennial, oil-seed bearing biofuel feedstocks including Jatropha curcas.

Assisted with lab projects associated with the development of ancillary co-products of biofuel feedstocks.

Compiled and analyzed data and wrote reports for various field and lab projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Environmental Science · Agriculture · Renewable Energy
